name: Wildflower posy
description: Meadow flowers tied with twine, picked this morning.
appearance: A small bunch of mixed wildflowers, daisies and cornflowers, tied with a loop of twine.

name: Potted fern
description: A small fern in a clay pot, hard to kill.
appearance: A small leafy green fern in a round terracotta clay pot.

name: Moss ball
description: A damp, velvety ball of pond moss in a dish.
appearance: A round velvety green ball of moss sitting in a shallow white ceramic dish.

name: Seed packets
description: Paper twists of herb and bean seed, labelled by hand.
appearance: Three small brown paper seed packets, hand labelled, fanned out.

name: Lavender soap
description: A pale cake of scented soap wrapped in linen.
appearance: A pale purple bar of soap half wrapped in cream linen, with a sprig of lavender laid on it.

name: Honey cakes
description: Three sticky cakes in a paper bag, still warm.
appearance: Three small golden glazed honey cakes spilling from an open paper bag.

name: Candied plums
description: A small box of sugared plums.
appearance: A small open gift box of dark purple sugared plums.

name: Tin of loose-leaf tea
description: An upland black tea in a small painted tin.
appearance: A small square painted tea tin with a round lid, decorated with green leaves.

name: Bag of coffee beans
description: Roasted this week by the people who supply Spell & Sip.
appearance: A brown paper bag of roasted coffee beans, folded at the top, a few beans beside it.

name: Bottle of spiced cider
description: Strong, sweet and best drunk in company.
appearance: A dark amber glass bottle of cider with a swing-top stopper and an apple on its label.

name: Salt pretzels
description: Knotted bread crusted with coarse salt.
appearance: Two knotted brown pretzels crusted with coarse white salt.

name: Ruled ledger
description: A hardback accounts book with ruled pages, for people who still think better on paper.
appearance: A closed hardback accounts ledger with a dark green cloth cover and red corners.

name: On Money and Credit
description: A much-argued classic of economics, in a battered student paperback.
appearance: A battered thick paperback book with a plain blue cover and a gold coin emblem.

name: Book of furrow hymns
description: A pocket book of the Order's hymns with a ribbon marker.
appearance: A small pocket hymn book in dark red leather with a ribbon marker hanging from it.

name: Pink sketchbook
description: Thick drawing paper between rose-coloured boards.
appearance: A sketchbook with rose pink board covers and a black elastic band, a pencil laid across it.

name: Old rail map of the Expanse
description: Out of date, beautifully drawn, slightly foxed. Two of the portal lines on it were never built.
appearance: An old folded railway map, yellowed, partly unfolded to show fine drawn lines.

name: Deck of cards
description: A worn deck. Possibly marked; the seller won't say.
appearance: A worn deck of playing cards fanned out, the ace on top, with a creased card box.

name: Silk ribbon
description: A length of bright silk for hair or a wrist.
appearance: A coiled length of bright red silk ribbon.

name: Lace choker
description: Fine black lace with a small silver clasp.
appearance: A black lace choker necklace with a small silver clasp, laid in a loop.

name: River stone
description: A smooth grey stone that holds the sun's warmth.
appearance: A smooth flat oval grey river stone.

name: Whetstone
description: A fine-grained stone for keeping a competition blade honest.
appearance: A rectangular grey sharpening whetstone on a small wooden block.

name: Tooled duty belt
description: Sturdy leather with a plain brass buckle, made to carry a blade and a radio and to last.
appearance: A coiled sturdy brown tooled leather belt with a plain brass buckle and a sword frog.

name: Set of picks
description: Sold as 'ward-testing tools'. Nobody is fooled.
appearance: A small leather roll opened to show a row of thin steel lockpicks.

name: Glass vials
description: Six stoppered vials in a padded case, for careful potion-work.
appearance: An open padded case holding six small empty stoppered glass vials.

name: Retro game cartridge
description: A classic for a console older than you are. The label is worn and the save file is someone else's.
appearance: A grey retro video game cartridge with a worn colorful label.

name: Charm-circuit kit
description: A solder-it-yourself board that takes one small enchantment. The box says ages ten and up.
appearance: A small green electronics circuit board with a soldering iron beside it, in an open cardboard box.

name: Refurbished earbuds
description: Good sound, one careful owner, a case with a scratch on it.
appearance: A pair of white wireless earbuds in their open charging case, the case slightly scratched.

name: Warded phone case
description: A slim case with a drop-ward stitched into the lining. Rated for one flight of stairs.
appearance: A slim dark blue phone case with a small rune stitched in silver thread.

name: Cup of Ember Ramen
description: The instant version of Cauldron's famous dish. Heats itself when you pull the tab, usually.
appearance: A cup of instant ramen noodles with a red and orange flame design and a pull tab lid.

name: Can of Sparkroot
description: An energy drink in a can that hums slightly. Popular in exam season.
appearance: A tall slim aluminum drink can, electric green with a yellow lightning root design.

name: Lucky Seven scratchcard
description: Seven petals to scratch. The odds are printed on the back in small type.
appearance: A lottery scratchcard printed with seven flower petals, one scratched, with a coin beside it.

name: Phone charger
description: A charger and cable, because everyone has lost theirs.
appearance: A white phone charger plug with its cable neatly coiled.

name: Lavender bath salts
description: A jar of scented salts for a long soak.
appearance: A glass jar of pale purple bath salts with a cork lid and a small wooden scoop.

name: Box of chamomile tea
description: Twenty bags of something calming, from the shelf by the till.
appearance: A small cardboard box of chamomile tea bags, yellow, with a daisy flower on it.

name: Study tonic
description: A licensed focus tonic in a brown bottle. One before a lecture, never two.
appearance: A small brown glass medicine bottle with a black screw cap and a plain white label.

name: Pocket speaker
description: A speaker the size of a plum that is louder than it has any right to be.
appearance: A tiny round portable speaker, plum sized, dark grey with a fabric grille and a wrist strap.

name: Game controller
description: A wireless controller in translucent purple.
appearance: A wireless game controller in translucent purple plastic.

name: Charm-light desk lamp
description: A desk lamp with a small light-charm in place of a bulb. Dims when you tell it to.
appearance: A small modern desk lamp with a glowing warm orb of light in place of a bulb.

name: Quartz point
description: A clear crystal the length of a finger, sold for focusing small workings and bought mostly because it is pretty.
appearance: A clear pointed quartz crystal the length of a finger.

name: Pouch of spell components
description: Dried herbs, salts and powders in labelled twists, for potion-work and practicals.
appearance: A small drawstring cloth pouch, open, with twists of paper and dried herbs spilling out.

name: Charm bracelet
description: A fine silver chain with one small luck-charm on it and room for more.
appearance: A fine silver chain bracelet with a single small four-leaf charm.

name: Tarot deck
description: Seventy-eight cards in a velvet bag. The Bloom is trump twenty-two.
appearance: A deck of tarot cards half out of a purple velvet bag, the top card showing a flower.

name: Facsimile grimoire
description: A printed copy of a four-hundred-year-old spellbook, marginal notes and all.
appearance: A thick old spellbook with a dark leather cover, metal corners and a clasp.

name: A Heretic's History of the Furrow
description: A history of the Order by one of its own priestesses. Not banned, exactly.
appearance: A hardback history book with a black dust jacket and a plowed furrow emblem in gold.

name: Antique atlas
description: Hand-coloured maps of the Expanse from before the railways.
appearance: A large antique atlas with a worn brown leather cover and gold tooling, a compass rose on the front.

name: Questionable artefact
description: A small brass thing with a hinge and no obvious purpose. The label says only "opens".
appearance: A small odd brass mechanical object with a hinge, gears and a tiny keyhole.

name: Vintage silk scarf
description: A printed silk scarf older than you, in very good condition.
appearance: A folded silk scarf with a colorful vintage floral print.

name: Old band T-shirt
description: Faded tour dates on the back, from a band that split up before you were born.
appearance: A folded faded black band T-shirt with a cracked white print of a rose.

name: Worn leather jacket
description: Soft with age, mended at one elbow by someone who knew how.
appearance: A soft worn brown leather jacket with a patched elbow.

name: Second-hand paperback
description: A novel with a cracked spine and someone's bus ticket for a bookmark.
appearance: A second-hand paperback novel with a cracked spine and a ticket sticking out as a bookmark.

name: Heartsease draught
description: A small bottle of something rose-gold you brewed yourself. It makes you easy to warm to for a day.
appearance: A small round glass bottle of glowing rose-gold liquid with a cork stopper.

name: Bloom cordial
description: A sweet dark cordial of your own brewing, to be poured for two. It quiets whatever she takes against the Bloom, for a day.
appearance: A squat dark glass bottle of deep purple cordial with a wax-sealed cork and two tiny glasses.

effects.telling: You shared a cordial he brewed, and you know what it does: for today, what you take against the Bloom will not hold. You drank it knowing that.

name: Charmed confection
description: A box of small sweets you made and charmed at the stove. Nobody has ever been sorry to be given one.
appearance: A small open box of round pastel sweets that faintly sparkle.

name: Stillwater
description: A flask of water from below that has never moved. In a fight it puts someone back on her feet.
appearance: A round-bottomed glass flask of perfectly clear still water with a cork, faintly glowing blue.

name: Grounding salt
description: Grey salt from the old pipes. In a fight it settles a pregnant woman's surge at once.
appearance: A small open leather pouch of coarse grey salt crystals.

name: Spring tonic
description: Warm from the source and faintly bitter. Drink it for energy, or use it below to steady someone.
appearance: A small clay bottle with a cord around its neck, steam rising from its open top.

name: Resonance token
description: A charged disc that hums against the palm. Set off beside a woman, it warms her to you for a day.
appearance: A flat round bronze disc engraved with concentric rings and a rune, glowing faintly pink.

effects.telling: Something has you warmer toward him than usual today, and more curious: you feel it as your own mood, and do not question it.

name: Stamina band
description: A wristband of your own making, charged and ready to trigger.
appearance: A handmade wristband of braided leather with a small copper plate and a glowing green charge light.
